**Risk flags:**
- Revenue fell 20.7% from 2023 to 2024  
- Low interest coverage 1.3484 in 2024  
- Director 3 holds 72.7% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Sinar Everbright Trading Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company that runs an online retail business for baby products and toys in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. It was incorporated on 29 December 2007, has five directors and a share capital of RM 100,000; the largest shareholder, Director 3, owns 72.7% of the equity. The company received unqualified audit opinions for 2022‑2024 and has no recorded legal cases.
